transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have some questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, like gardening, after 1 week. It’s best to avoid strenuous work, heavy lifting, and swimming for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some mild light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust, and things may just seem brighter than usual. If that’s the case, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful — that would need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that. One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly over time. If it is still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I have for now. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
